देखिए बॉलीवुड और खेल जगत की चटपटी खबर! 🔥
भारतीय क्रिकेटर पृथ्वी शॉ और आकृति अग्रवाल ने अपनी 6 महीने की मंगनी टूटने के हफ्तों बाद फिर से मेल कर लिया है।
रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक, पहले इस जोड़े ने अपनी मंगनी तोड़ ली थी और एक नोट भी ड्रॉप किया था, जिसके बाद पृथ्वी शॉ के चीटिंग रूमर्स और उनके 'Every Rumour Is True' पोस्ट ने काफी तूल पकड़ा था।
लेकिन अब एक्ट्रेस आकृति अग्रवाल ने खुद कंफर्म कर दिया है कि दोनों फिर से एक साथ आ गए हैं।
क्या आपको लगता है कि मशहूर हस्तियों के ऐसे रिश्तों में उतार-चढ़ाव पब्लिसिटी स्टंट होते हैं या सच?

ctx.title: Anirudh Ravichander skips out on work till January 2027? Composer likely to resume with Sandiyar teaser
ctx.summary:
Anirudh Ravichander and businesswoman Kavya Maran reportedly tied the knot on November 11, 2026. As the musician takes a break following his wedding, it appears that he might return to work only in January 2027. 
 Anirudh Ravichander to step away from work till 2027? 
 According to a report by Valai Pechu, Anirudh Ravichander is planning to take a break from his musical commitments until January 2027. The composer is expected to resume work next year, reportedly beginning with the teaser for Kamal Haasan's Sandiyar. The film is also expected to enter full-fledged production around that time. 
 However, this remains a report for now, and the musician has not made any official announcement regarding his work break. 
 Anirudh Ravichander and Sunrisers Hyderabad owner  Kavya Maran  recently tied the knot in a self-respect marriage ceremony, opting for a simple celebration instead of traditional wedding rituals and just exchanged pendants with each other. 
 For those unfamiliar with Kavya Maran, she is the daughter of Sun Group chairman Kalanithi Maran. She is widely known for her candid appearances at IPL matches, which frequently go viral on social media. 
 Superstar  Rajinikanth  also attended the wedding ceremony and blessed the newlyweds.
